Definition: Neocortex volume in cm3 as compiled by the authors; neocortex = grey + white matter of the cerebral cortex, excluding grey matter of palaeocortical structures (entorhinal cortex, schizocortex, hippocampus, amygdala)

Definition: Reference number of the volume source in the paper's reference list (refs 84-99)

Definition: Neocortex ratio after Dunbar: neocortex volume / (brain volume - neocortex volume), as printed

Source Note: Paper Table 1 column "Nr"; definition in Methods 2.2

Definition: Encephalization index as printed: Ei = ln( brain mass / body mass^0.64 ); the slope 0.64 was estimated from brain/body mass data for 493 mammalian species provided by Gonzalez-Lagos et al. 2010 (paper ref 83)
Note: The PDF text layer renders the minus sign as a leading '2' (e.g. -2.014 prints as 22.014); signs were restored at build and are consistent with the paper's formula (only Homo sapiens is positive). Brain and body masses themselves are NOT in this table
Source Note: Paper Table 1 column "Ei"; formula in Methods 2.2
